**Definition** (free text, with reference(s), please. PubMed ID format is PMID:XXXXXX)
stem cell memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell:
A CD4-positive memory alpha-beta T cell with stem-like properties that is long-lived, retains a naïve-like phenotype, and exhibits self-renewal and multipotent differentiation capacity. This cell acts as a stem-like reservoir capable of regenerating central and effector memory T cell subsets.
References: PMID:19525962; PMID:21926977; PMID:28060797

comments.body:
This should be a seperate ticket: 

Additional notes or concerns from [KazuhiroNakagawa](https://github.com/KazuhiroNakagawa)
Regarding memory T cell subsets (TCM, TEM), these terms are currently annotated with an in taxon constraint for human, but their labels do not include ", human".
Is there a clear rule or convention within the Cell Ontology for labeling species-specific cell types?
For example:

central memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell (or CD8) [TCM]
effector memory CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell (or CD8) [TEM]
In addition, the following marker sets are commonly used for stem cell memory T cells (TSCM):

Human: CD45RA⁺ CCR7⁺ CD62L⁺ CD95⁺
Mouse: CD62L^high CD44^low Sca-1⁺ CD122⁺ CD27⁺ CD127⁺
Since the marker expression profiles of TSCM differ between humans and mice,
it would be preferable to establish separate terms for each species.
In that case, creating corresponding mouse terms for TCM, TEM would help maintain consistency across the entire memory T cell subset structure.

To clearly distinguish naïve T cells from TSCM, the expression of CD95 (Fas) is an important marker in humans. However, the current naïve T cell term is shared between humans and mice.
To accurately represent CD95 expression differences, it may be preferable to create separate naïve T cell terms for humans and mice.

naive thymus-derived CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell (or CD8)
Human: CD95⁻ (CD45RA⁺ CCR7⁺ CD62L⁺)
Mouse: CD95 not included in the definition.

title: [NTR] Add new terms for stem cell memory T cells (TSCM): CD4+ and CD8+ subsets
